newsitem.title: BRAZIL: One killed, four injured in Brazil plane crash.
newsitem.headline: One killed, four injured in Brazil plane crash.

text.p: A Boeing 737 aircraft landing at the Amazon airport of Carajas on Friday drove off the runway and crashed into some trees, killing one crew member and injuring four passengers, airport officials said.

Brazilian airport operator Infraero said Varig flight 265 was making a stopover in Carajas in the northern state of Para when the crash occurred. The plane was en route from the northern city of Belem to the capital, Brasilia.
The injured were taken to a hospital in the area and released shortly afterwards. The airport was closed for one hour after the accident.
Details on the cause of the crash were not immediately available.
